subject: Tenancy hardening evidence & onboarding sprint plan
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Tenancy hardening evidence & onboarding sprint plan

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Acme Corp's procurement and security review we need a compact evidence packet and a short onboarding timeline that shows how Redwood will accomplish tenancy hardening for a dedicated/private deployment. Specifically we need:

- A concise network diagram (control plane vs data plane) showing tenant isolation boundaries for both Dedicated and Private deployments.
- The isolation model (logical + enforced controls) and where policies are applied (hypervisor, VPC, edge).
- Mapping to SIG/CAIQ controls and any SOC 2 controls affected.
- A proposed 1-week onboarding sprint plan for a pilot environment and a list of deliverables.

Attached is our standard questionnaire (initial-questionnaire.xlsx) — we've pre-filled the sections we know. Can you confirm whether you can deliver an evidence bundle by EOD 2026-12-17 for our internal review? If not, propose an achievable date.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Security, Acme Corp
security@acme.com

Attachments: initial-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tenancy hardening evidence & onboarding sprint plan

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the filled questionnaire. We can provide a compact evidence bundle that covers: network diagrams for Dedicated and Private, a narrative of the isolation model, a SIG-to-CAIQ mapping summary, and a one-week pilot onboarding plan.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Kimberly will produce the annotated network diagrams and VPC sketches (deliverable: vpc-sketch.png).
- I'll assemble the tenancy narrative + pilot runbook and produce a short summary PDF (redwood-tenancy-summary-v1.pdf).
- Soojin will extract the relevant control mappings into a CSV control matrix (control-matrix.csv) and flag any SOC 2 intersections.

Question for you: do you need packet-level egress rules or just control-plane policy descriptions for this stage? If you need packet samples we'll need one extra day to capture sanitized examples.

I'll target an internal draft by 2026-12-12 and a packaged bundle for you by 2026-12-16, which should meet your requested window. If you need it sooner we can compress but will likely have to omit the packet samples.

Meeting option: can we pencil a 30-min sync Thu 2026-12-11 10:00 AM PT to walk the artifacts? If that's good, I'll send an invite.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-tenancy-summary-v1.pdf (pdf)

Hi Sarah,

Attaching the preliminary VPC sketch and control matrix excerpts for your review. A few notes:

- The diagram separates control plane (management APIs, orchestration) from data plane (inference hosts, KV caches) with an explicit egress proxy layer for customer-managed VPCs.
- Tenant isolation leverages: dedicated GPU pools for Dedicated customers, strict subnetwork routing and security groups in Private deployments, and per-tenant KV encryption keys managed through customer KMS where requested.
- For SIG/CAIQ we provide a mapping file that calls out the specific evidence artifacts (diagram page numbers, log samples, control IDs) rather than raw logs.

Deliverables attached: vpc-sketch.png (PNG) and control-matrix.csv (CSV). We can also add a small sanitized packet capture if you confirm the need.

- Kim

Attachments: vpc-sketch.png (png), control-matrix.csv (csv)

Michael / Kim —

Thanks, this looks good and in line with what our auditors expect. Packet samples are optional for the first pass — please skip unless you have a sanitized example ready.

Confirmed: 2026-12-16 bundled evidence is acceptable. Please include:

- Annotated network diagram (labelled control vs data plane)
- Tenancy narrative PDF with explicit points on where enforcement occurs
- SIG/CAIQ mapping CSV with links to the artifacts inside the bundle
- Any SOC 2 control intersections called out inline

I'll accept a Drive link to the bundle and will route it to our procurement & audit teams on receipt. If you can pop the HubSpot deal (ACME-3742) with the deliverable links and send the DocuSign for the pilot SOW, we can fast-track the procurement.

Thanks again,
Sarah Lin
Head of Security, Acme Corp
